    StartersDark chocolate gummy lolly barkDark and white chocolate swirled with gummy lollies, honeycomb and marshmallowsHow to make it300g dark chocolate150g white chocolate100g gummy lollies, chopped50g honeycomb, crushed50g mini marshmallows2 tbsp sprinklesMelt the dark and white chocolate separately.Spread the dark chocolate over a lined tray and drizzle with the white, then swirl with a skewer.Scatter over the lollies, honeycomb, marshmallows and sprinkles, pressing them in lightly.Chill until set.Smash into shards.Candy kart pretzel rodsPretzel rods dipped in white chocolate and rolled in sprinklesHow to make it20 pretzel rods200g white chocolate3 tbsp sprinklesMelt the white chocolate.Dip each pretzel rod two-thirds of the way in, letting the extra drip off, and roll in sprinkles straight away.Lay on baking paper to set.Stand them in a glass like a bunch of candy karts.Hero's Duty loaded nachosThe alien shooter game Hero's DutyHow to make itAs written, serves 4Corn chips loaded with spiced beef and beans, melted cheddar and pickled jalapeño, blitzed in the oven, with salsa, guacamole and sour cream.Brown 400g beef mince with 1 diced onion and 2 tsp taco spice, add a drained can of black beans and 100ml water and simmer 5 minutes.Spread 300g corn chips over a large tray, spoon over the beef and scatter with 200g grated cheddar and sliced jalapeños.Bake at 200°C for 8 minutes until melted.Top with tomato salsa, mashed avocado with lime and sour cream.Buffalo wings with blue cheeseThirty years a bad guy. Wings help.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsRalph's wrecking ball meatballsEight big parmesan beef meatballs browned and simmered in sauceHow to make it600g beef mince1/2 cup breadcrumbs1 egg50g parmesan, grated2 garlic cloves, crushed2 tbsp olive oil700g tomato passata200g spaghettiMix the mince, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan and garlic. Roll into big meatballs.Brown the meatballs all over in the oil.Add the passata and simmer.Boil the spaghetti until al dente and drain.Serve the meatballs and sauce over the spaghetti.Niceland chicken and leek pot pieThe Nicelanders' apartment buildingHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken, leek and mushroom in a creamy thyme sauce under a golden puff pastry lid, the kind of pie the Nicelanders bake for Felix.Brown 800g diced chicken thighs, then remove.Soften 2 sliced leeks and 200g mushrooms in 40g butter, stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then 300ml chicken stock and 150ml cream.Simmer until thick, add thyme and the chicken and season.Pour into a pie dish, top with a puff pastry sheet, brush with egg and cut a slit.Bake at 200°C for 25 minutes until golden.SweetsFelix's anniversary pieCinnamon green apples under a lattice crustHow to make it6 green apples, sliced50g butter100g brown sugar1 tsp ground cinnamon3 sheets of shortcrust pastry, thawed500ml vanilla ice cream1 tube gold icingPeel and slice the apples.Cook the apples with the butter, brown sugar and cinnamon until just soft.Cool the filling.Line a pie dish with shortcrust.Fill and weave a lattice top.Bake at 190°C until golden.Pipe a gold star on top and serve with ice cream.DrinksCola ice cream floatCold cola poured over vanilla ice cream until it frothsHow to make it300ml vanilla ice cream1 L cola, coldPut a scoop of ice cream into each tall glass.Slowly pour the cola over the top so it fizzes up and froths over the rim like a volcano.Stand the glasses on plates and serve with long spoons.Root beer from the tapSlide it down the bar, Tapper.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
